distribution.narrative: Baseline and Wang et al. (2021) both support Xinjiang. Wang et al. samples multiple Xinjiang localities; this confirms rather than expands the province-level synthesis.

host_note: Picea schrenkiana is retained. Chinese common-name wording differs between sources (天山云杉 / 雪岭云杉), but the scientific host identity is consistent.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips hauseri Reitter, 1895.

taxonomic_history.name: Ips ussuriensis
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 107.

taxonomic_history.name: Ips hauseri
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current identity Ips hauseri Reitter, VSN_3411, is unchanged. Wang et al. (2021) adds the first mtDNA COI data reported for the species.
